changelog:
- Fixed the update handoff helper so its generated Python script contains valid line breaks and can run after the main app exits.
- Added update-apply.log diagnostics so file-copy or restart failures are no longer hidden.
- Made the helper verify the staged package and destination before replacing files, then relaunch the platform launcher after applying the update.
- Bumped the internal updater comparison version while keeping the displayed release at 1.1.
- Fixed updater error reporting by decoding byte output into readable text.
- Added .7z package extraction using py7zr with a native 7-Zip fallback.
- Added accept/decline confirmation before downloading an update.
- Automated update installation and application restart on Windows and Linux.
- Updated the minimum py7zr version for compatible 7z extraction.
